content: Monitoring and evaluation will be integrated into the dissemination and implementation process to collect data and information regarding the adoption, application, and impact of the new recommendations. The World Health Organization (WHO) intends to collaborate with national authorities to incorporate questions about the new recommendations and healthcare workers’ experiences in implementing them into relevant routine national training assessments and other evaluations. The WHO Steering Group will continue to monitor research developments in the management of chronic pain in children, particularly focusing on interventions where the certainty of evidence has been assessed as low or very low.
